title: Voice engine API
what: The HTTP API the voice-server binary answers: health, events, voices, syntheses and their sound, transcriptions, encodings, script readings and voice servers, with the wire bodies they take and answer, in src/http.rs and src/wire.rs.

title: Voice engine client
what: The engine's published client: one method for each route, sending and reading the wire bodies and carrying a refusal back as its status, code and sentence, in src/client.rs.

title: Voice harness plugin
what: The plugin a coding harness takes the engine in: the bmo-voice mcp server on standard input and output, its five tools each a thin call through the client, and the ahas-voice skill, in src/mcp.rs and plugin/.

title: Voice OpenAPI document
what: The engine's OpenAPI 3.1 contract, generated from its wire types and tools, kept as docs/openapi.json and printed by bmo-voice openapi, in src/openapi.rs.
